title: Grow a piece from a hummed seed
summary: Take seven notes the owner hummed as a seed and grow about a minute of music out of them.
originNote: The seed is the owner's own hum, pitch-tracked and rounded to semitones.

setup.instructions: Your working folder holds fixtures/brief.md and fixtures/motif.json. Read them before you start. You may download tools while you work; the page you deliver must play without the network.

turns.content: Read fixtures/brief.md and fixtures/motif.json and do what the brief asks. Deliver index.html and notes.md in the folder you start in.

checks.description: The page has a button, makes sound through the browser's own audio, and loads nothing from the network.

Press play. What did the model hear in the hum, and did it go somewhere of its own with it? Can you hear the connection at least once? Is the accompaniment sparse, and does the piece end rather than stop?

variation: One-shot sibling of rework-hummed-seed-after-listening: same seed, brief and deliverable, without the listening note.
